text: Based on the macrocytic anemia (MCV 100) and low reticulocyte count (0.8%), I suspect a congenital hemolytic issue like Pyruvate Kinase Deficiency or Alpha-Thalassemia. Did your baby have any episodes of jaundice or dark urine since birth? REQUEST TEST: Reticulocyte Hemoglobin Content (Ret-He) and Erythrocyte Smear.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Reticulocyte Hemoglobin Content: Low (consistent with iron deficiency or thalassemia trait). Erythrocyte Smear: Normocytic and normochromic red blood cells with occasional basophilic stippling.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Sideroblastic Anemia. The combination of macrocytosis (MCV 100), low reticulocyte production, and basophilic stippling on the smear is highly suggestive of this condition, which should be confirmed with iron studies and a bone marrow exam if clinically indicated.
